svg.title: Drip / substrate greenhouse — Substrate irrigation & return
svg.desc: Substrate irrigation & return. 8 equipment references and 9 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
svg.text: Substrate irrigation & return · declared connections · illustrative equipment symbols
